newsitem.title: USA: Kerr omits prfrd div, gets covenant waiver.
newsitem.headline: Kerr omits prfrd div, gets covenant waiver.

text.p: Kerr Group Inc said on Tuesday that it obtained an extension of waivers of certain financial covenants through September 30, 1996 from its lenders and the company omited a dividend on its class B, series D preferred stock for the quarter.

The company, which is in talks about refinancing its debt, said it agreed to prepay to the lenders, by September 16, 1996, $100,000 in aggregate amount of the outstanding principal of the senior notes and an unsecured note.
Terms of any refinancing will require approval of the Company's existing lenders, Kerr said.
Kerr Group said it has received an extension of the maturity date on an unsecured note to September 30, 1996.
